name: Dreamworld: The Visual Novel
source:
DREAMWORLD: The Visual Novel is a cute, weirdcore/dreamcore visual novel where you wake up in a unknown town called "Starward" in the place: dreamworld!

Meet new friends, explore places and play games, all whilst receiving some weird memories off how you got there and what happens next...

[From [url=https://xezien.itch.io/dreamworld-the-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《DREAMWORLD：视觉小说》是一部可爱、怪异/梦幻核心的视觉小说，你在一个名为“星际”的未知小镇中醒来：梦幻世界！

结识新朋友、探索地方、玩游戏，同时接收一些关于你如何到达那里以及接下来会发生什么的奇怪记忆……

[来自[url=https://xezien.itch.io/dreamworld-the-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
